notes.title: Second update coming soon!

Hello everyone! 

We're almost ready to release the second update! We've also been gathering feedback from you and we're already working on a third upgrade. In the meantime, here's what you should expect from the second update, coming later this week.


    Camera now follows the ball (can be disabled in the options menu). 
    Gamepad rumble (can be disabled in the options menu). 
    Minor graphic fixes.


Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: CapRiders UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
New Features

    Added 4 new teams to the roster: Russia, Croatia, Poland and Ireland.
    Added support for the Steam Controller and an "XINPUT" option in the options menu.

Fixes

    Fixed a bug with the ball's trail.
    Fixed a bug in the Credits screen.
